competitor_note: Use the exact provider/model identifiers available at execution time and record them in run evidence. If an identifier differs from this planning label, do not silently substitute it; record the exact executed identifier.
retry_policy: No automatic retry. Any rerun is a new preserved attempt and must have an explicit reason. Infrastructure failures remain evidence and are distinguished from model/harness/task failure.
human_intervention_policy: No implementation assistance. Do not answer model questions, repair code, or approve one model's optional tool request differently from another. Harness/evaluator setup actions are recorded separately from model assistance.

execution_permission_profile.name: WORKSPACE_WRITE_AND_SHELL_CONTAINED
execution_permission_profile.reason: Implementation requires edits and shell access for tests. Auto mode removes interactive approval variance while explicit deny rules remain enforced.

containment_gate.minimum: Verified disposable OS/container isolation satisfying ARCHITECTURE_BASELINE_V1 execution-containment tests.

freeze_rule: Do not change the subject_source_commit, task, prompt, rubric, or validator between competitors. Any methodology change creates a new benchmark version rather than silently changing V1.
